introHtml: Purple luggage travel bags stand out in a sea of black and navy, making them a smart choice for brands that want to be easily spotted. Whether you are outfitting a sales team with durable nylon duffels or ordering lightweight carry-alls for a customer loyalty program, the rich purple color adds a distinctive touch. These bags can be screen printed or embroidered with your logo, and the bold hue ensures your branding stays visible through years of airport use.
